verdict.label: MIXED
verdict.action: No clear macro edge. Stay invested but selective — let the sector leaderboard pick your spots and keep sizing normal. Don't force new risk.

signals.name: Gold vs Silver
signals.plain: Gold is pulling ahead of silver — a classic fear signal. Mild caution for stocks.
signals.why: The gold-to-silver ratio climbs when investors turn defensive.

signals.name: Indian Stocks vs Gold
signals.plain: Indian stocks are beating gold — money prefers equities over safe-havens. Good sign.
signals.why: When stocks outrun gold, risk appetite is healthy.

signals.name: Market Breadth
signals.plain: The broader market is keeping pace with large-caps — healthy, broad participation.
signals.why: Nifty 500 vs Nifty 50 — broad participation signals a durable move.

signals.name: US 10-Year Yield
signals.plain: US bond yields are rising — global money gets pricier, a headwind for Indian equities.
signals.why: High US yields pull foreign money out of emerging markets like India.
